name: Emanation (Joy)
scaffolding_intent: Emits sparkle particles around an entity: on a character, joy or wonder; on an object, that it is shiny, new, or beautiful

parameters.name: tint
parameters.description: RGB tint shift applied to entity pixels (additive)

parameters.name: tintSaturation
parameters.description: How strongly the tint is applied (0 = no tint, 1 = full tint)

correction_intent: Child attributed a wrong emotion to a character the scene shows happy, excited, proud, or amazed (big smile, arms raised, jumping, wide eyes at something wonderful), or described as dull, old, or dirty an object the scene shows shiny, new, or beautiful (crown, ring, trophy). Target that character or object.
suggestion_intent: A character is visibly happy, excited, proud, or amazed (big smile, arms raised, jumping) and the child has not said so, or an object is visibly shiny, new, or beautiful and the child mentioned it without saying so. Target that character or object. Requires a visible cue.
